observations: Photo 0 shows a black standing gas cooker with an oven compartment below.
Cooktop has 4 burners: 3 gas burners plus what appears to be 1 solid hotplate.
No brand name, logo, or model number is visible anywhere on the unit.
Unit appears clean with wood-grain oven handle, sitting on a tiled floor next to a parked car.
No flame, ignition, or oven interior shown; no power/gas connection visible in the shot.
Small gas canister partially visible at bottom left of frame, not connected to cooker.

claims.evidence: No before/after photos, no receipt or refurbishment documentation; single static photo only.
No photo or clip of burners lit, oven heating, or ignition working.

risks.risk: Burners or ignition may not light or may light unevenly.
risks.proof: Short video of all burners igniting and flame color/steadiness.

risks.risk: Oven compartment may not heat or may have faulty thermostat.
risks.proof: Photo/video of oven interior lit and heating with visible temperature dial response.

risks.risk: Gas leak or damaged hose/regulator from refurbishment.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of gas connection point, hose, and regulator seal.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working, as leaks make unit unsafe/unusable

risks.risk: Rust or dents on sides/back not visible in single front angle.
risks.proof: Photos of rear and side panels.
risks.if_unproven: priced at low end for cosmetic uncertainty

risks.risk: Missing or non-original knobs/parts replaced in 'refurbishment' could affect function.
risks.proof: Close-up of knobs and ignition switches.

proof_requests: Video of all 3 gas burners and the hotplate igniting and running for 10+ seconds.
Video of oven heating with visible flame or heating element.
Close-up photos of gas hose/regulator connection and rear panel.
Photo of any brand/model plate if present.
response.reason: Item is clearly identifiable as a standing gas cooker by type; working condition and refurbishment claims are unverifiable from a single static photo, so it is priced at worst case (as not working) against comparable standing gas cookers in Oyo.
